Aircraft Structural Integrity Components.name: Titanium

Aircraft Structural Integrity Components.name: Glass

Aircraft Structural Integrity Components.name: Steel Ingots
Aircraft Structural Integrity Components.reasoning: Used in some high-stress fittings or joints due to strength; less common to reduce weight but still relevant in structural components.

Propulsion System (turboprop Or Piston E.name: Titanium

Aircraft Guidance System.name: Aluminum
Aircraft Guidance System.reasoning: Used in housings and heat sinks to manage thermal conditions of guidance electronics.

Aircraft Electrical Power System.name: Ceramic
